x-e-e1-01.title: Thola izenzo ezingahambelani nesaziso sechibi lokubhukuda
x-e-e1-01.topic: Ukubingelela okufushane, izaziso, nezithombe ezidwetshwe ngamagama
x-e-e1-01.goal: Fanisa imithetho emithathu esesazisweni nesimo somuntu ngamunye, khetha amacala aphula imithetho, bese usho isizathu ngesiNgisi.
x-e-e1-01.material:
Isaziso emnyango wechibi lokubhukuda (kubhalwe ngamagama kuphela, akukho sithombe):

Imithetho Yechibi
1. No running.
2. Swim caps on, please.
3. Under 8? Come with a grown-up.

(grown-up = an adult)

Abantu abane baya echibini.
U-Mina ungu-7. Uza nonina, futhi unesigqoko.
U-Jun ungu-10. Uza yedwa, futhi akanaso isigqoko.
U-Tom ungu-6. Uza nomfowabo. Umfowabo ungu-9. U-Tom unesigqoko.
U-Sue ungu-11. Uhamba ngezinyawo eya echibini yedwa, futhi unesigqoko.
x-e-e1-01.prereq.1: Izabizwana ezilula njengo-I, you, he, she
x-e-e1-01.s.s1.prompt: Khetha wonke umuntu ophula imithetho esesazisweni.
x-e-e1-01.s.s1.hint.0: Yenza ithebula lobudala bomuntu ngamunye, ukuthi weza nobani, nesigqoko, eyodwa ngesikhathi.
x-e-e1-01.s.s1.hint.1: Thola ukuthi umthetho ngamunye ubhanqwe nolwazi luni, bese ubaxhumanisa ngemigqa.
x-e-e1-01.s.s1.r.a: Hlola ukuthi uqhathanise iminyaka ka-Mina nokuthi weza nobani nomthetho 3.
x-e-e1-01.s.s1.r.c: Cabanga ukuthi umuntu weza no-Tom ufana yini nomuntu umthetho okhuluma ngaye.
x-e-e1-01.s.s1.r.d: Fanisa iminyaka ka-Sue nendlela ahamba ngayo nemithetho 1 no-3 ngokwehlukana.
x-e-e1-01.s.s1.explain: U-Jun akanaso isigqoko, ngakho uphula umthetho 2. U-Tom uneminyaka engaphansi kuka-8, kodwa umfowabo oze naye uneminyaka engu-9, ngakho akayena 'umuntu omdala', futhi u-Tom uphula umthetho 3. U-Mina weza nonina, no-Sue uneminyaka engu-11, ngakho kulungile ukuthi ahambe eze yedwa.
x-e-e1-01.s.s2.prompt: Tshela umfowabo ka-Tom emusheni owodwa noma emibili ngesiNgisi. Xhumanisa nomthetho isizathu sokuthi u-Tom akakwazi ukungena echibini manje.
x-e-e1-01.s.s2.hint.0: Qala uqhathanise iminyaka ka-Tom nenombolo emthethweni 3.
x-e-e1-01.s.s2.hint.1: Qala nge-'Tom is under 8, so ...' bese ubhala okudingekayo ngemva kwalokho.
x-e-e1-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingabe uxhumanise isizathu sokuthi kungani u-Tom engakwazi ukungena nomthetho (under 8)?
x-e-e1-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingabe usho ukuthi kungani umfowabo engeyena umuntu omdala?
x-e-e1-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ingabe imisho yakho yesiNgisi mifushane futhi lula ukuyiqonda?

x-e-e1-02.topic: Ukubingelela okufushane, izaziso, nezithombe ezidwetshwe ngamagama
x-e-e1-02.title: Lungisa umugqa ongalungile esazisweni esiphelelwe ekopishiwe
x-e-e1-02.goal: Qhathanisa isaziso sezinto ezilahlekile nomyalezo umngani awukopishe kusuka kuso, umugqa ngomugqa, uthole umugqa ongalungile, bese uwubhala kabusha ngokulungile.
x-e-e1-02.material:
Isaziso ebhodini lezaziso lesikole (kubhalwe ngamagama kuphela):

Lost and Found
Found: a blue water bottle, near Room 3.
Ask Ms. Park in Room 1 after school.

Umngani wakho u-Jia ubone lesi saziso ngoba wayefuna ibhodlela lakhe lamanzi, futhi wathumela umyalezo ku-Hana. U-Hana ufuna ukuwuqhathanisa nesaziso.
x-e-e1-02.prereq.1: Ukufunda izinombolo zamakamelo afana no-Room 1, Room 3
x-e-e1-02.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umugqa owodwa emyalezweni ka-Jia ohlukile esazisweni.
x-e-e1-02.s.s1.hint.0: Khomba amagama esazisweni (umbala, inombolo yekamelo, igama lomuntu) eyodwa ngesikhathi bese uwafanisa nemigqa yomyalezo.
x-e-e1-02.s.s1.hint.1: Kumugqa ngamunye womyalezo, wufanise nomugqa wesaziso okopishwa kuwo, bese ufuna igama elingafaniyo.
x-e-e1-02.s.s1.explain: Umugqa 4 awulungile. Esazisweni, u-Ms. Park useKamelweni 1, kodwa umyalezo uthi Room 3, ngakho uphutha. U-blue emugqeni 2 ufana naleso saziso, futhi u-Room 3 emugqeni 3 yindawo lapho ibhodlela lathola khona, ngakho kulungile.
x-e-e1-02.s.s2.prompt: Lungisa umugqa ongalungile osanda kuwuthola ukuze uhambelane nesaziso, bese uwubhala ngesiNgisi.
x-e-e1-02.s.s2.hint.0: Funda futhi umugqa osesazisweni oqala ngo-'Ask'.
x-e-e1-02.s.s2.hint.1: Kunegama elilodwa kuphela lokushintsha emshweni wokuqala. Thola lapho leli gama likhona.
x-e-e1-02.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingabe uhlole esazisweni inombolo yekamelo lapho u-Ms. Park ekhona?
x-e-e1-02.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingabe uhlukanise indawo lapho ibhodlela lathola khona (Room 3) nendawo yokubuza (Room 1)?

x-e-e1-03.topic: Ukubingelela okufushane, izaziso, nezithombe ezidwetshwe ngamagama
x-e-e1-03.title: Yenza isaziso semigqa emibili ozosibeka emnyango weklasi
x-e-e1-03.goal: Hlulela ukuthi yimuphi ulwazi (kuphi, nini) umfundi wesaziso aludingayo, khetha isaziso esifanele, bese ubhala isaziso sakho semigqa emibili.
x-e-e1-03.material: Abafundi beKlasi 3 basekamelweni lomculo kusukela ngo-10:00 kuya ku-11:00 namuhla. Bafuna ukubeka isaziso emnyango weklasi. Isivakashi esifika eklasini leKlasi 3 ngo-10:30 sizofunda lesi saziso.
x-e-e1-03.prereq.0: Amagama alula afana no-music room, today
x-e-e1-03.s.s1.prompt: Khetha isaziso esivumela isivakashi esifika ngo-10:30 ukuthi sazi kokubili 'ukuthi siye kuphi' no-'ukuthi silinde isikhathi esingakanani'.
x-e-e1-03.s.s1.hint.0: Qala ubhale imibuzo emibili isivakashi esingafuna ukuyibuza.
x-e-e1-03.s.s1.hint.1: Phawula eyodwa ngesikhathi ukuthi isaziso ngasinye siphendula leyo mibuzo emibili yini.
x-e-e1-03.s.s1.r.b: Cabanga ukuthi ungasho yini ukuthi 'later' isikhathi esingakanani.
x-e-e1-03.s.s1.r.c: Hlola ukuthi lesi saziso sisho zombili izinto isivakashi esifuna ukuzazi yini.
x-e-e1-03.s.s1.r.d: Hlola ukuthi sinesikhathi sokuqala kuphela, noma sinesikhathi sokuphela nasso.
x-e-e1-03.s.s1.explain: c isho kokubili indawo (music room) nesikhathi sokuphela (11:00). Ku-a indawo ishodayo, ku-b ukuthi isikhathi esingakanani kushodayo, futhi ku-d isikhathi sokuphela sishodayo.
x-e-e1-03.s.s2.prompt: Bhala isaziso ngesiNgisi, semigqa emibili, ozosibeka emnyango weklasi leKlasi 3. Kumele sifake indawo nokuthi kuze kube yisikhathi sini.
x-e-e1-03.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ubhale igama elilodwa ngalinye le-kuphi, nini, nobani.
x-e-e1-03.s.s2.hint.1: Bhala 'kuphi' emgqeni wokuqala no-'nini' emgqeni wesibili, bese ulungisa.
x-e-e1-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingabe umuntu odlulayo angasifunda futhi asho ukuthi kuphi, nokuthi kuze kube yisikhathi sini?
x-e-e1-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingabe ufake ulwazi oludingekayo kuphela emigqeni emibili?
x-e-e1-03.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ingabe ukhethe ulwazi oluthile olwengeziwe ofuna ukulungeza (isb., Class 3, Please wait)? (Akuphoqelekile)

x-e-e1-10.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ingabe ufake ulwazi oludingekayo kuphela emigqeni emibili?
x-e-e1-10.title: Qedela umlayezo othi 'Ngizobambezeleka' ukuze umama angakhathazeki
x-e-e1-10.goal: Thola ulwazi olushodayo emlayezweni womugqa owodwa bese ubhala wena umlayezo wemigqa emibili otshela umama ukuze angakhathazeki.
x-e-e1-10.material: Ngemva kwesikole, uzoya eklabhini yomculo futhi mhlawumbe uzofika ekhaya sekuvuliwe. Ufuna ukuthumela umlayezo wombhalo kumama wakho. Lokho umama afuna ukukwazi ngu-'sikhathi sini ozofika ngaso ekhaya' no-'uphi nokuthi wenzani'.
x-e-e1-10.prereq.0: Imisho efana no-I'll be home at 5.
x-e-e1-10.s.s1.prompt: Ngumuphi umlayezo otshela kokubili ukuze umama aqiniseke?
x-e-e1-10.s.s1.hint.0: Bhala phansi imibuzo emibili kamama bese umaka ukuthi umlayezo ngamunye uyayiphendula yini.
x-e-e1-10.s.s1.hint.1: Hlukanisa ukuthi 'late' noma 'don't worry' ulwazi noma amagama nje okuthulisa imizwa.
x-e-e1-10.s.s1.r.b: Hlola linye ngalinye ukuthi iyiphendula yini imibuzo emibili umama ayibuzayo.
x-e-e1-10.s.s1.r.c: Hlola ukuthi unalo ulwazi othi 'uzofika nini'.
x-e-e1-10.s.s1.explain: b itshela kokubili isikhathi ozofika ngaso ekhaya (5 o'clock) nokuthi uphi nokuthi wenzani (iklabhu yomculo). Abanye bashoda oyedwa kwababili.
x-e-e1-10.s.s2.prompt: Bhala umlayezo wemigqa emibili kumama ngesiNgisi. Kumele ufake isikhathi ozofika ngaso ekhaya nokuthi uphi (noma kungani uzobambezeleka). Ungakhetha isikhathi ngokukhululeka.
x-e-e1-10.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ubhale ngesiKorea izinto ezimbili umama ebengafuna ukuzibuza.
x-e-e1-10.s.s2.hint.1: Bhala umugqa wokuqala njengamagama okubambezeleka nesizathu, nomugqa wesibili njengesikhathi sokufika.
x-e-e1-10.s.s2.placeholder:
Isibonelo: Mom, I'll be late today.
I'm at ... and I'll be home at ...
x-e-e1-10.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Umama angakwazi ukwazi ukuthi uzofika nini?
x-e-e1-10.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Angakwazi ukwazi ukuthi uphi nokuthi wenzani (kungani ubambezelekile)?

x-e-e1-04.title: Ngubani okhulumayo? Ukushintsha ukucabanga kwakho njengoba izinkomba ziyanda
x-e-e1-04.topic: Izinkomba mayelana nokuthi ngubani, yini, nokuthi kuphi
x-e-e1-04.goal: Isikhathi ngasinye lapho umugqa wenkulumo wengeza inkomba, hlulela futhi ukuthi ngubani okhulumayo, bese uchaza inkomba enqumayo ngesiNgisi.
x-e-e1-04.material: Uzobona imigqa umuntu ayisho, umugqa owodwa ngesikhathi. Landela izinkomba bese ucabanga ukuthi ngubani okhulumayo.
x-e-e1-04.thinking.0: Gcina amathuba amaningana avulekile kusukela enkombeni eyodwa
x-e-e1-04.prereq.0: Amagama alula afana no-book, card, week
x-e-e1-04.prereq.1: Ukubingelela okufana no-Welcome, Can I help you?
x-e-e1-04.s.s1.prompt: Imigqa iphuma eyodwa ngesikhathi. Isikhathi ngasinye, khetha bonke abantu abangaba ngabakhulumayo.
x-e-e1-04.s.s1.hint.0: Kubantu owabashiya esinyathelweni sangaphambilini, hlola futhi kuphela ukuthi bafanelana nomugqa omusha yini.
x-e-e1-04.s.s1.hint.1: Emugqeni omusha, thola amagama ahlaba 'into' noma 'isikhathi'.
x-e-e1-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Ubheka lo mugqa owodwa kuphela, ngubani ongaba ngumkhulumi?
x-e-e1-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Kusuka emugqeni wokuqala kuphela, abantu abaningana bayenzeka, njengomsebenzi wesitolo noma umqaphi wethala lezincwadi.
x-e-e1-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Abantu basezitolo nabo banikeza lolu hlobo lokubingelela.
x-e-e1-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Cabanga ukuthi lokhu kubingelela kuvame ukusetshenziswa ebhasini yini.
x-e-e1-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Abantu basethaleni lezincwadi nabo babuza amagama anikeza usizo.
x-e-e1-04.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Abantu basezitolo ezithengisa izincwadi nabo banikeza ukubingelela okufanayo.
x-e-e1-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: Uma uhlanganisa imigqa emibili, ngubani ongenzeka?
x-e-e1-04.s.s1.st.1.after: Izincwadi zivele, ngakho umsebenzi wesitolo sezimpahla nomshayeli webhasi bayashiywa. Kusala umqaphi wethala lezincwadi nomsebenzi wesitolo sezincwadi.
x-e-e1-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Cabanga ukuthi kuyahambisana yini nokuvela kwezincwadi.
x-e-e1-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Uma uhlanganisa yonke imigqa emithathu, ngubani ofanelana kakhulu?
x-e-e1-04.s.s1.st.2.after: Njengoba umkhulumi ecela ukubona ikhadi futhi esho ukuthi ungagcina incwadi amaviki amabili, kungenzeka kakhulu ukuthi ngumqaphi wethala lezincwadi odlulisela izincwadi. Esitolo sezincwadi, uma uthenga incwadi ngokuvamile akukho sikhathi.
x-e-e1-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Hlola ukuthi kuyafanelana nenkomba entsha yini.
x-e-e1-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Hlola ukuthi kuyafanelana nenkomba entsha yini.
x-e-e1-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Cabanga ukuthi 'amaviki amabili' nekhadi kuzosho ini esitolo sezincwadi.
x-e-e1-04.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Cabanga ukuthi amagama ikhadi namaviki amabili enza ini.
x-e-e1-04.s.s1.reflect: Uma unqume umuntu oyedwa kusuka emugqeni wokuqala kuphela, bheka emuva ukuthi ukucabanga kwakho kwashintsha kanjani njengoba izinkomba ezintsha zivela. Amathuba aya encipha ngenkomba ngayinye.
x-e-e1-04.s.s2.prompt: Bhala ngesiNgisi inkomba eyodwa emugqeni wokugcina ekwenza ucabange 'umqaphi wethala lezincwadi' kunokucabanga 'umsebenzi wesitolo sezincwadi'.
x-e-e1-04.s.s2.hint.0: Emugqeni wokugcina, thola igama elizosetshenziswa ngokuhlukile esitolo sezincwadi nasethaleni.
x-e-e1-04.s.s2.hint.1: Bhala umusho owodwa ngohlobo: '__ means ~, so ...'.
x-e-e1-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingabe usho ukuthi inkomba oyikhethile ihlukanisa ngempela isitolo sezincwadi nethala lezincwadi?
x-e-e1-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingabe uchaze ukuthi 'card' noma 'two weeks' kwenza ini?

x-e-e1-05.topic: Izinkomba mayelana nokuthi ngubani, yini, nokuthi kuphi
x-e-e1-05.title: I-cinema noma isiteshi sesitimela? Ukuqhathanisa amandla ezinkomba
x-e-e1-05.goal: Qhathanisa ukuthi izinkomba kuxoxo zinquma kakhulu kangakanani indawo, bese uchaza ngesiNgisi ukuthi kungani izinkomba ezibuthakathaka zodwa zingenele.
x-e-e1-05.material:
Abantu ababili bakhuluma kanje.
A: Two tickets, please.
B: Which film?
A: The 3 o'clock one.
B: Row F or Row G?
A: Row F, please.

(Row = a line of seats, film = a movie)

Umngani wakho u-Yuna uthi, "Tickets! It's a train station." Umngani wakho u-Min uthi, "It's a cinema (a movie theater)."
x-e-e1-05.thinking.1: Azi ukuthi inkomba eyodwa ingafanelana nezindawo eziningana
x-e-e1-05.prereq.0: Amagama alula afana no-ticket, film, seat
x-e-e1-05.s.s1.prompt: Khetha zonke izinkomba ezisekela kakhulu isitatimende sika-Min ('cinema').
x-e-e1-05.s.s1.hint.0: Hlola inkomba ngayinye nge-'Ingabe ingasetshenziswa nakweminye indawo?'
x-e-e1-05.s.s1.hint.1: Cabanga ngokusho amagama afanayo esiteshini sesitimela noma epaki lezilwane.
x-e-e1-05.s.s1.r.a: Cabanga ukuthi i-cinema yiyo yodwa indawo edinga amathikithi yini.
x-e-e1-05.s.s1.r.b: Cabanga ukuthi igama elithi film lingelendawo ephi.
x-e-e1-05.s.s1.r.c: Cabanga ukuthi i-cinema yiyo yodwa indawo lapho izikhathi ziveza yini.
x-e-e1-05.s.s1.r.d: Cabanga ukuthi umugqa nohlamvu kunquma ini.
x-e-e1-05.s.s1.explain: Film (ifilimu) no-Row F/G (umugqa wezihlalo) yizinkomba eziqinile ezikhomba i-cinema. Ticket no-3 o'clock yizinkomba ezibuthakathaka ezingasetshenziswa nasesiteshini sesitimela, epaki lezilwane, noma ehholo lekhonsathi.
x-e-e1-05.s.s2.prompt: Phendula u-Yuna ngesiNgisi emusheni owodwa noma emibili. Bhala ukuthi kungani 'tickets' kuphela kungeke kunqume ukuthi siyisiteshi sesitimela.
x-e-e1-05.s.s2.hint.0: Cabanga ngezindawo ezimbili noma ezintathu ezinye ezisebenzisa 'ticket'.
x-e-e1-05.s.s2.hint.1: Zama ukuqala ngohlobo 'Tickets can be for ... too.'
x-e-e1-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingabe uqambe okungenani enye indawo lapho amathikithi asetshenziswa khona?
x-e-e1-05.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingabe uphawule izinkomba ezikhomba i-cinema (film, Row)?

x-e-e1-06.goal: Uma kusele abakhethiwe abaningana, khetha umbuzo ohlukanisa kahle kakhulu abakhethiwe, bese wenza umbuzo wakho wesiNgisi.

Umngani ucabanga ngento. Kunezinkomba ezimbili.
Hint 1: It is round. (It is round and roundish)
Hint 2: It is in the kitchen. (It is in the kitchen)

Kunabakhethiwe abane: apple, plate, clock, kanye ne-cup. Ufuna ukuthola eyodwa ngokubuza imibuzo ye-yebo/cha.
